Install Node.js (LTS version) from

https://nodejs.org



Open Command Prompt / Terminal



Check if Node and npm are installed

Type:

node -v

npm -v



Go to your project folder

Type:

cd path/to/your/project



Make sure package.json exists in that folder



Install dependencies

Type:

npm install



Wait until installation completes



The node\_modules folder will be created automatically



Do not download or upload node\_modules manually



If node\_modules is missing later, just run

npm install again
